digest.component_or_area: GitHub workflow CI/CD and test suite
propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml performs redundant work already covered by _build-and-test.yml matrix cells (Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 + macOS).
Deleting the import-linter job removes one of eight concurrent job slots from _optionality.yml, bringing the total within GitHub Free org cap of 20 concurrent slots.
The two optionality test files carry no pytest markers and are not filtered by paths, so they will continue to run in default suite selection after job deletion.

A checked-in test must assert that tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py and tests/unit/test_optional.py collect exactly 9 items under default selection to prevent future contributors from accidentally removing optionality coverage via markers or paths filters.
The job deletion is safe because optionality guard tests run in fresh subprocess or parse AST directly, not in a polluted worker process.
